items.script:
import maya.cmds as cmds
import maya.mel as mel

sel = cmds.ls(sl=1)
ns = self.namespace

if cmds.getAttr(ns+"character.name") in ["dog"]:
    ctrl = "l_f_leg_control"
else:
    ctrl = "l_arm_control"

cmds.select(ns+ctrl)

if cmds.objExists(ns+"character.name") and cmds.getAttr(ns+"character.name") in ["pig"]:
    import importlib
    import rigStudio_picker.animTools.switchIkFk as switchIkFk
    importlib.reload (switchIkFk)
    switchIkFk.switchIkFk()
elif cmds.getAttr(ns+"character.name") in ["dog", "penguin", "cat", "bear", "bearFemale", "hare", "panda"]:
    import importlib
    import pk_selector_switchIKFK
    importlib.reload (pk_selector_switchIKFK)
    pk_selector_switchIKFK.switchIkFk()
elif cmds.getAttr(ns+"character.type") == "humanAnimaccord":
    import importlib
    import rs_switchIkFk
    importlib.reload (rs_switchIkFk)
    rs_switchIkFk.switchIkFk()
else:
    mel.eval("human_changeFkIk -sl;")

if cmds.objExists(ns+ctrl+".fkIk"):
    switch_attr = (ns+ctrl+".fkIk")
else:
    switch_attr = (ns+ctrl+".ikFk")

if cmds.getAttr(switch_attr):
    self.text.set_text("IK")
    self.set_color(QtGui.QColor(160, 170, 120, 255))
else:
    self.text.set_text("FK")
    self.set_color(QtGui.QColor(100, 130, 150, 255))

if sel:
    cmds.select(sel)
else:
    cmds.select(clear=1)

self.view.scene().update()
